name: Reifa Padoma Kurain
original_name: レイファ・パドマ・クライン
source:
Rayfa Padma Khura'in is the mystic princess of Khura'in. She is a priestess who can use a "Pool of Souls" to reveal what a victim saw and felt before their demise.

[From [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Rayfa_Padma_Khura'in]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
